summary.text: Catelin Drey, a Democrat from Sioux City, represents District 1 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's page lists service from September 15, 2025, and lists the occupation as account executive.

paragraphs.text: Drey won an August 2025 special election for Iowa Senate District 1, held after the June 2025 death of Sen. Rocky De Witt, and was sworn in on September 15, 2025.
Iowa Capital Dispatch described Drey as a marketing firm account executive and mother.

sources.title: Democrat Catelin Drey sworn in to Iowa Senate
